mutations.diagnosis: The policy requires strict precedence: security > billing > access > other. Priority rules are: P0 for all-user outages (active, not historical) or credential theft; P1 for blocked individuals/groups or unresolved financial issues; P2 for questions, feature requests, resolved incidents. Training failures show misclassifications: 'All users unable to authenticate' is access but labeled security (P0), 'Payment processing down' is billing (P0) but labeled security (P0), 'past unauthorized login' is security (P2) but labeled access (P2), etc. The root issue is overreliance on literal phrasing without checking for active threats vs. resolved incidents or financial contexts. Candidates must explicitly handle: 1) Ongoing vs. historical outages (P0), 2) Unresolved financial issues (P1), 3) Security vs. billing precedence (security overrides billing).
